[
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first-line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness, as well as for melanoma in situ.",
  "Surgical margins for melanoma excision should be based on tumor thickness.",
  "When melanoma is suspected, the entire lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1‑3 mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large melanoma lesions such as those on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and genital lesions.",
  "The consensus rate for the recommendation that the whole lesion be excised with a narrow margin is 100 % (21 out of 21 experts)."
